title: 2001 HMMT February Team Problem 11
statement: Define \(a\) ? \(=(a-1) /(a+1)\) for \(a \neq-1\). Determine all real values \(N\) for which \((N ?) ?=\tan 15\).

solutions.text: Let \(x=N\) ?. Then \((x-1) \cos 15=(x+1) \sin 15\). Squaring and rearranging terms, and using the fact that \(\cos ^{2} 15-\sin ^{2} 15=\cos 30=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), we have \(3 x^{2}-4 \sqrt{3} x+3=0\). Solving, we find that \(x=\sqrt{3}\) or \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\). However, we may reject the second root because it yields a negative value for ( \(N\) ?)?. Therefore \(x=\sqrt{3}\) and \(N=\frac{1+x}{1-x}=\sqrt{\frac{1+\sqrt{3}}{1-\sqrt{3}}}=-2-\sqrt{3}\).
